drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy with CC

timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient seen and examined at bedside. 48-year-old male admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.55, creatinine 0.88-1.19, hemoglobin 13.1-13.2, platelets 250-256, sodium 140, wbc 7.6-8.1; vitals dbp 70-74, heart_rate 81-84, map 91-94, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 17-18, sbp 131-138, spo2 95-96, temp 36.7-36.9
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Acute kidney injury.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient seen and examined at bedside. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 1.44-1.67, hemoglobin 13.1-13.2, platelets 246-249, sodium 140, wbc 7.7-8.2; vitals dbp 68-74, heart_rate 80-84, map 90-94, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-17, sbp 132-136, spo2 95-97, temp 36.7-36.9
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Lactated Ringer's 1 L IV bolus
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 48-year-old male, length of stay 3 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Acute kidney injury, resolved. Follow up with primary care in one week. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed.
